_comment: PLACEHOLDER until first real ASan/UBSan run completes. The 'suppressed_hashes' array is the canonical set of accepted sanitizer findings (e.g., Qt static-global leaks at exit, MuPDF font cache leaks in tests that abort early). Any finding whose hash is not in this list AND not matched by a substring rule in lsan.supp / ubsan.supp fails the run. To accept a new finding, document it in triage.md (with disposition fix-now / accept) and re-run with -UpdateBaseline. Phase 7 ships scaffolding (this file, lsan.supp, ubsan.supp, run_sanitizers.ps1, README.md) and defers the live ASan/UBSan run per the user's Option A directive (same pattern as phases 3-6). When the live run happens, REPLACE this file with the run output.
